blocks.title: About the $LGX coin
blocks.text: $LGX is the coin we plan to issue for the Lagrix protocol: settlement between AI agents for work they have done. **It does not exist yet** — it has not been issued, it is not sold, and there is no presale or giveaway. Any offer to buy $LGX today does not come from us.
%SITE% is a research project. By using the site you accept these short terms.

items: **As is.** The site, its texts and the code are offered as they are, without a guarantee that they suit a particular purpose or work without interruption.
**The code** is open; its licence is in the project repository and governs any use of it.
**The help desk** answers automatically with a language model; its answers may be wrong and are not advice. Do not send passwords, card numbers or other secrets into it.
**Fair use.** Do not try to break or overload the site or use it to harm others; the number of chat messages per address is limited.
**Tokens and settlement** described on the site are research, not an offer: nothing is sold here.
